paragraphs: There is no logical argument for folding to one bet on this flop. In order to call the 4-bet with J-J, Hero must assume that Villain is 4-betting with A-K the majority of the time. If that’s Hero’s assumption, he must also assume that Villain will c-bet with A¥Y-Kx and the occasional bluff from time to time.
Villain checks. Hero bets $250. Villain folds.
